items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: And you know George Bernard Shaw or somebody said

ctx.x: You go over there a lot?

Yeah. I mean they have jazz, not everywhere, but generally jazz is considered more of a cultural thing, more art. And you know George Bernard Shaw or somebody said that if you travel and go to foreign countries that’s the only time you get to know your own country you know. And America, I am an American, I love America, I was born here and went to school here you know. I served in the armed forces here as I said before. But there’s an awful lot — America’s not perfect you know. There are a lot of traits America…
good. And I’m not expecting people to stop in the street, who am I after all, a clarinet player. But I get a much better feeling out of Europe, being a musician there.
